jobs.occupation: 170026 Clinical Professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology (Fixed-Term, 5 Years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology 
 (Fixed-Term, 5 Years)

  Department of Clinical Medicine
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

  University of Copenhagen

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology to commence as soon as possible. The externally funded professorship is combined with a consultancy at Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet, Department of ORL, Head and Neck Surgery and Audiology in the Capital Region.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the professorship and the consultancy. In order to be considered for the position, the applicant must send two applications: one to the Faculty (the professorship) and one to the hospital (the consultancy) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the consultancy. This also applies to applicants who are already employed as consultants at the Hospital. Please find the advertisement for the consultancy at www.sundhedsjobs.dk/

  Both the professorship and the consultancy will be financed by Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet.

  Find information about the department.

  Job description
 In the consideration of applications for the professorship, the main emphasis will be on the applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific work at an international level within the area of Otorhinolaryngology.

  The professor's responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination – The professor is expected to conduct and lead high-quality clinical and translational research within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiology. Relevant research areas that are prioritized will be head and neck surgical oncology and biomarker development. The professor is furthermore expected to contribute to the development and implementation of new diagnostic and treatment approaches within the field. 	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination – The professor will contribute actively to undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing medical education through research-based teaching. In particular, the professor is expected to contribute to teaching and examination within the Clinical Course in Otorhinolaryngology and the Medical Specialty Focused Course and Exam in Otorhinolaryngology, and to supervise medical students, PhD candidates, and clinical researchers. The professor will contribute to the integration of current research findings into clinical teaching, curriculum development, and specialist training. 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers – The professor is expected to play a central role in the development and strategic direction of the research environment within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiologThe professor is expected to contribute to innovation and societal impact through the development, evaluation, and implementation of new knowledge, technologies, and clinical practices. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for a clinical professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution, and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to:

   	
• Document a high degree of original academic production at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline 	
• Manage research and other management functions, e.g. engage in the university’s external academic activities, as well as knowledge and technology transfer 	
• Provide research-based teaching   The professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of five years. Extension is possible if the employed candidate performs well in the position.

  For the professorship the appointee will receive a pensionable annual honorarium of 219.882,33 DKK (1 August 2026 level).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Head of Department Nicolai W. Albrechtsen, nicolai.albrechtsen@regionh.dk.

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

  Application
 The application must be submitted in English and must include the following documents:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Uploads of maximum 10 publications to be considered in the assessment 	
• Self-declaration form (Template under Nyttige links - Upload the completed and mandatory form as “Other relevant material”) 	
• Teaching portfolio (Guidelines / Template for inspiration under Nyttige links) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• A complete list of publications   Application procedure 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee. When the assessment work is completed, each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, Sunday, 8 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position are likely to be held in the month of March 2027.

• 
Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

• 
Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

• 
Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

• 
Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

• 
Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

• 
Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

• 
Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

• 
En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

• 
Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant (Staff Scientist) in Cancer Bioinformatics and Molecular Oncology
jobs.description:
The Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a Research Assistant (Staff Scientist) position in the research group of Professor Paolo Ceppi.

The successful candidate will contribute to ongoing research activities focused on understanding the molecular and metabolic mechanisms underlying cancer development and progression, with a particular emphasis on bioinformatics and computational approaches in oncology.

The position aims to strengthen and further develop bioinformatics research within the group, facilitating the integration of computational analyses with experimental cancer biology and supporting the development of new research directions.

Main Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be expected to:

• 
Conduct independent and collaborative research in cancer biology, with particular attention to metabolic regulation and molecular mechanisms of tumor progression.

• 
Develop and apply bioinformatics and computational approaches for the analysis of complex biological datasets, including transcriptomic and other omics data.

• 
Support the integration of bioinformatics analyses with experimental research activities within the laboratory.

• 
Contribute to identifying molecular pathways and regulatory networks involved in cancer progression and cellular plasticity.

• 
Participate in the preparation of scientific publications, research proposals, and future grant applications.

• 
Contribute to teaching activities at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, including the BMB835 course.

• 
Collaborate with researchers within the department and contribute to the scientific development of the research group.

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

• 
A PhD degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, cancer biology, or a related field.

• 
Documented postdoctoral research experience in molecular oncology or cancer-related research.

• 
Strong expertise in bioinformatics and computational analysis of biological datasets.

• 
Experience with transcriptomic data analysis and the interpretation of molecular pathways and regulatory networks.

• 
Knowledge of cancer metabolism and molecular mechanisms involved in cancer progression.

• 
A demonstrated ability to conduct research independently and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary research teams.

• 
A strong scientific publication record.

• 
Good communication skills and an interest in contributing to teaching activities.

Research Environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Paolo Ceppi at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark.

The group investigates molecular mechanisms regulating cancer progression, with particular interests in cancer metabolism, cellular plasticity, and molecular regulatory networks. The position will play an important role in strengthening the computational and bioinformatics capabilities of the laboratory and supporting the development of innovative research projects and future funding applications.

Employment Details

• 
Position: Research Assistant (Staff Scientist)

• 
Workplace: Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark, Odense

• 
Starting date: 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter

• 
Duration: 1 year

• 
Application deadline: 27 October 2026

jobs.occupation: 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher in Abstractions for Quantum Software
jobs.description:
The Quantum Hub at University of Southern Denmark is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a two-year post to conduct research on abstractions for quantum software. As quantum computing advances towards large-scale fault-tolerant devices, robust hardware-independent software abstractions are becoming increasingly important for bridging the gap between quantum algorithms and physical implementations, and for making quantum computing accessible to software developers. We welcome applicants strongly motivated to contribute to this growing field with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

* Quantum algorithms

* Quantum circuit synthesis and optimisation

* Gaussian boson sampling

* Topological quantum computing

* Quantum error correction

* Fault-tolerant quantum computing

* Quantum programming languages and programming abstractions, including LLM-assisted quantum programming

* Quantum intermediate representations

* Quantum compilation, including AI/ML-assisted compilation techniques

* Quantum software engineering

* Quantum software design and testing

* Developer tools and usability in quantum software

The targeted starting date of the position is 1 January, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Note: We are not permitted to directly contact your academic references, so please ensure their letters have reached us by the deadline.  The application requirements are detailed at the end of this advertisement.  

Requirements
The candidate must have a PhD degree in mathematics, physics or computer science. 

Situation of the position
The position at the SDU Quantum Hub, will be situated at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark. SDU Quantum Hub is established with the ambition to create a highly international and interdisciplinary group within a broad spectrum of quantum research. Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs. 

Assessment
Shortlisting may be used. Shortlisted applicants will be assessed by an assessment committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. As part of the overall assessment, the applicant may be called for interview.

Conditions of employment
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. 

Information of salary rates can be found at: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu/international-staff

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence
jobs.description:
A position as Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence is available at the Department of Management, Society and Communication for appointment on 01 January 2027.

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS, part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with engaged students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

MSC’s research and teaching addresses the dynamic relations between business and society and the responsible management thereof. To this end, MSC mobilises a wide range of knowledge within management and business disciplines as well as the broader social and human sciences, organized in three interconnected research environments: CBS Sustainability; Centre for Business and Development Studies; the Communication, Organisation and Governance Research Cluster.

The position includes 

• 
Planning and conducting teaching on responsible business governance and corporate responsibility due diligence, with a particular focus on risk management, reporting and finance between sustainability expectations and compliance. The part-time lecturer is expected to have solid knowledge of sustainability (risk-based) due diligence, international governance frameworks on responsible business conduct, EU law and policy on corporate sustainability, demands on companies, social expectations of responsible business conduct, and business uptake, responses and challenges in the interface of management and growing public regulation of responsible business and corporate sustainability.

• 
Online teaching—blended learning

• 
Student supervision

• 
Preparing teaching materials and exam questions

• 
Conducting exams and other evaluations

Qualifications

To fill this position, you have a master’s degree and:

• 
High-level practical experience at a high level, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or

• 
Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).

• 
A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits based on their relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.

• 
Employment as part-time lecturer presupposes that teaching qualifications are included in the assessment of applicants for an external professor.

jobs.occupation: Director, Creative Operations
jobs.description:
Location: Copenhagen

We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

Creative Operations & Project Management

• 
Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• 
Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• 
Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• 
Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

• 
Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• 
Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• 
Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• 
Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

Agency & Vendor Management

• 
Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• 
Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• 
Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

Change Management & Transformation

• 
Lead change initiatives that enable successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.

• 
Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

• 
Influence stakeholders across the business to deliver sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

Budget & Resource Management

• 
Own budget planning for Creative Operations systems, technology investments, and operational needs in partnership with the Head of Production.

• 
Forecast and optimize resource allocation across internal teams and external partners.

• 
Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

Qualifications & Experience

• 
Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• 
Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• 
Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

• 
Experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI-enabled or automation solutions within creative, marketing, or operational environments.

• 
Experience leading RFPs, developing business cases, and delivering technology implementations in partnership with Digital & Technology teams.

• 
Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, content production, localization, and asset management.

• 
Demonstrated success managing agency and vendor partnerships, including localization, customization, and technology providers.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills.

• 
Proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across complex organizations.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

• 
Experience with budget planning, financial management, and investment prioritization.

• 
Passion for leveraging technology, automation, and innovation to improve creative effectiveness and operational excellence.

Reports to: VP Brand Creative

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.
